## About
North Texas Dent Pros fixes hail damage and dents. We're a local business with roots in North Dallas, working out of Savannah, TX, and we treat the folks we work with like neighbors, because they are.
We know a hailstorm leaves you with a damaged car and a stack of paperwork. So we handle it with you: we file the claim, set you up with a rental and bring your car back when it's done. Customers mention Eric and Luke by name for keeping them in the loop the whole way.
We're rated 5 on Google from 33 reviews.

## Services
- Hail damage repair: We repair hail damage and work to bring your vehicle back to its pre-damage condition.
- Dent repair: Dent repair for cars and trucks, whether or not hail caused it.
- Claim filing help: Our team files your claim, gets you into a rental car and delivers your vehicle back to you.

## FAQ
Q: How long will the repair take?
A: Once your insurance approves the vehicle, turnaround is typically 7-10 business days, and we try to beat that.

Q: Will I get aftermarket parts?
A: No. We only use OEM factory parts on anything that can't be fixed with PDR.

Q: Do I need to pay anything upfront?
A: No. Hail repair with us is a $0 out-of-pocket cost process.

Q: What if I don't have rental car coverage?
A: If your full coverage insurance doesn't include rental coverage, we'll put you in a rental car free of charge during the repair.

Q: Which insurance companies do you work with?
A: We work with any and all insurance companies in the greater DFW area.
